'''Brent Haertlein''' (also published as '''Brent Haertlin''')<ref name="dt-10512">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10512 (R&RAP) I think I can  I think I can], DeckTech (Brent "TheGhost" Haertlein, 18 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10512/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10512/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018115722/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10512/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''TheGhost''') posted a [[Light]] [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|There Is Good In Him]] list on DeckTech in September 2000. He played at [[RamapoCon II Constructed (5 May, 7 pm)]] on 5 May 2000, with a Light Side mains deck (no objective) according to Doug Faust's tournament report.
